name: new-tab-dashboard
description: A Manifest V3 browser extension that replaces the new tab page with a local productivity dashboard.

scripts.firefox:lint: web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files README.md PRD-TRD.txt package.json package-lock.json scripts tests .gitignore amo-metadata.json web-ext-artifacts
scripts.firefox:build: web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --ignore-files README.md PRD-TRD.txt package.json package-lock.json scripts tests .gitignore amo-metadata.json web-ext-artifacts
scripts.firefox:sign: web-ext sign --channel=listed --source-dir . --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --amo-metadata amo-metadata.json --ignore-files README.md PRD-TRD.txt package.json package-lock.json scripts tests .gitignore amo-metadata.json web-ext-artifacts --api-key=$AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret=$AMO_JWT_SECRET
